summary.text: Carol Alvarado is a Democratic member of the Texas Senate representing District 6 in Harris County, first elected in a 2018 special election. She is chair of the Texas Senate Democratic Caucus.

paragraphs.text: Alvarado served on the Houston City Council from 2002 to 2008 and was elected to the Texas House in 2008, serving five terms representing District 145 and chairing the Urban Affairs Committee.
She holds a B.A. in political science and an M.B.A. from the University of Houston.

In the Senate she serves on the Finance, Economic Development, Natural Resources, Nominations and Congressional Redistricting committees, and her page names economic development, public health and public education as her primary focus.
She is a native Houstonian and a member of St. Alphonsus Catholic Church.
